name: Hit Back
summary: Hit Back is an action Breakout-style game with 3 game modes: story mode, trial mode, and VS Mode. In the story mode, a princess is reading a storybook to four of her subjects when a Grim Reaper-like figure pops out of the book and grabs the princess and drags her into the storybook. Her friends try to grab her and are sucked into the storybook world too.
